description: Zyphra ZONOS2: a 28-layer GQA/MoE TTS backbone (16 experts, EDA router) over 9 delayed 1024-entry DAC codebooks, decoded by the 44.1 kHz Descript Audio Codec, with ECAPA speaker-embedding cloning.

request.name: seed
request.description: Sampler seed; random when omitted. Long-form chunk i uses seed + i.

request.name: max_tokens
request.description: Generated frames per text chunk (86.13 frames/s), including the 10-frame end-of-speech drain.

request.name: top_k
request.description: Top-k candidates per codebook (ties at the threshold are kept).

request.name: top_p
request.description: Nucleus probability per codebook; 0 disables it.

request.name: min_p
request.description: Drops candidates below min_p times the most likely one.

request.name: repetition_penalty
request.description: Penalty on codes seen in the repetition window, applied once per distinct code.

request.name: repetition_window
request.description: Generated frames of per-codebook history the repetition penalty looks at; 0 disables it.

request.name: repetition_codebooks
request.description: Leading codebooks the repetition penalty applies to; -1 applies it to all nine.

request.name: speaker_embedding_file
request.description: float32 .npy speaker embedding with shape [2048] or [1,2048], as written by encode_reference_only.

request.name: encode_reference_only
request.description: Return the --voice-ref speaker embedding as an .npy artifact without generating speech.

request.name: clean_speaker_background
request.description: Mark the reference as clean instead of noisy (a prompt marker row; cloning only).

request.name: accurate_mode
request.description: Add the accurate-mode marker row (on) or leave it out for expressive delivery (off); cloning only.

request.name: speaking_rate_bucket
request.description: Adds a speaking-rate conditioning row with this bucket; omitted = no rate row.

request.name: quality_buckets
request.description: Comma list of feature:bucket quality rows over lufs (0-11), estimated_snr (0-11), max_pause (0-11), estimated_bandlimit_hz (0-7), leading_silence_s (0-7) and trailing_silence_s (0-7); none disables every quality row.

request.name: fade_out_ms
request.description: Cosine fade over the last N milliseconds of the output.

request.name: text_chunk_size
request.description: Maximum Unicode code points per long-form text chunk.

request.name: text_chunk_mode
request.description: Text chunking policy for long-form input.

session.name: encoder_backend
session.description: Backend for the speaker encoder: cpu, or the session backend (same).

session.name: voice_cache_slots
session.description: LRU slots for computed speaker embeddings per reference clip; 0 disables caching.

session.name: stream_chunk_frames
session.description: Maximum frames per streamed decoder chunk.

session.name: stream_context_frames
session.description: DAC context frames on each side of a streamed chunk; 16 or more is seam-free.

session.name: disk_experts
session.description: Keep the routed expert banks in the GGUF/host memory and stage the selected experts through a bounded per-layer cache on the compute backend.

session.name: pin_experts
session.description: With disk_experts, hold the full expert banks in pinned host memory for direct uploads.

session.name: expert_cache_size
session.description: Expert slots per MoE layer with disk_experts; at least twice the largest routed top-k.

session.name: disk_expert_read_threads
session.description: Host workers copying selected experts with disk_experts and without pin_experts.

packages.description: F16 spine + Q8_0 experts backbone, DAC 44.1 kHz decoder, ECAPA speaker encoder (8.8 GB).
